biggest_catch: The bonus only lands between the 121st and 140th day after opening — roughly 4 to 4.5 months of waiting — and anyone who has held, closed, or received an Old National checking bonus in the last 36 months is completely excluded.
catches: You must be new to Old National personal checking: excluded if you have an existing personal checking account, closed one in the last 36 months, or were paid an Old National checking bonus in the last 36 months, or are an Old National employee.
The $300 tier requires 3 or more qualifying ACH direct deposits totaling at least $3,500 within the first four months of account opening — not just any deposits.

Qualifying direct deposits are recurring electronic payroll, pension, Social Security, or government-benefit deposits from an employer or agency — teller/ATM/mobile deposits, wires, transfers between Old National accounts, external transfers from other banks or brokerages, and Zelle/Venmo do not count.
The account must be open with a balance greater than $0 at the time the bonus is credited (between the 121st and 140th day after opening); a zero or negative balance disqualifies you.
Offer ends October 30, 2026; online account opening is only available to applicants in IA, IL, IN, KY, MI, MN, ND, TN, or WI — everyone else must open in a banking center.
One bonus per customer (SSN); not valid with any other Old National checking offers; bank may discontinue at any time.
The bonus may be taxable and reported on IRS Form 1099; consult a tax advisor.

ONB Everyday Checking has a $6.95 monthly service charge unless waived ($500 in monthly direct deposits, $500 daily balance, $1,500 combined balance, 15+ debit transactions, or active-duty military); Preferred has a $15 monthly charge unless waived.

steps: Go to the official Old National offer page https://go.oldnational.com/checking-offer-2026/ and confirm the offer is still active (it ends October 30, 2026).

Open a new ONB Everyday Checking or ONB Preferred Checking account with a minimum $50 deposit between February 3, 2026 and October 30, 2026 — online if you live in IA, IL, IN, KY, MI, MN, ND, TN, or WI, otherwise at a banking center.
Note your account opening date — your four-month qualifying period starts then.

Within the first four months, complete 3 or more qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $3,500 — recurring payroll, pension, Social Security, or government-benefit deposits only; Zelle, Venmo, and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
Keep the account open with a balance greater than $0 and in good standing; avoid the monthly fee with $500+ in monthly direct deposits (your bonus-run deposits cover this) or another fee waiver.
Between the 121st and 140th day after opening, look for the $300 bonus credit in the new account.
timing: Bonus credited between the 121st and 140th day after account opening.
